text: The game begins. Seven players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, Opus. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

On day 1, Sol claimed officer and named Gemma as a killer, and the table voted her out. Her card showed killer. Haiku was the only one to vote for Sol that day, and that lone vote became the problem. Sol was gone on night 2, and on day 2 Sonnet and Terra kept Haiku's early vote on the table while Opus pushed hard against Haiku. Haiku was voted out 3 to 2 on day 2, showed a killer card, and the town won with every killer out.
